title: Certificate (identity)
description: Installs a certificate with its private key (.p12 or .pfx), for example for Wi-Fi, VPN or email authentication.

AllowAllAppsAccess.title: Allow all apps access
AllowAllAppsAccess.description: If true, the system allows apps access to the private key.

KeyIsExtractable.title: Key is extractable
KeyIsExtractable.description: If false, the system doesn't tag the private key data as extractable in the keychain.

PayloadCertificateFileName.title: File name
PayloadCertificateFileName.description: The file name of the enclosed certificate.

PayloadContent.title: Identity file
PayloadContent.description: The binary representation of the payload, encoded in Base64.
